command: set -e; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "bc8a061e868951c0313d80ff1d93c5235912ce29"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; test -x "$ADB"; "$ADB" kill-server || true; "$ADB" start-server; sleep 2; "$ADB" devices -l; SERIALS="$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | sed '/^$/d')"; if [ "$SERIALS" = "RFCT70L7E8J" ]; then echo ADB_PHONE_RECOVERED=yes; else echo ADB_PHONE_RECOVERED=no; fi
